sources.label: Personal android patches compatible with Morphe
sources.author: Arkert
patch_list: Collapses Comunio's bottom ad-only layout container to reclaim space.
Prevents Comunio from preloading AdMob, Ad Manager/Prebid and Ogury fullscreen ads.
Hides the in-app purchase announcement for ad-free packages.
Prevents banner advertisements from loading in Comunio.
Prevents interstitial ads from interrupting Comunio.
Hides top announcements, including possible Plus promotions; may also hide important notices.
